shot.title: 毕业：快门之后还在笑
shot.start_end_and_action: A medium-wide candid smartphone angle from a friend a few steps to the side of the same graduation group. Start just after the group photo has been taken. The same boy and girl remain next to each other under the same tree, with identical faces and uniforms. They release their formal smiles into a spontaneous laugh as a classmate fans their face with an exercise booklet. The boy glances at the girl, then both look toward their laughing friend. Camera makes a tiny human adjustment but stays on the same side of the group. End on their relaxed shared glance, leaving half a second of calm reaction.
